description: ADD a wallet to your Robinhood Chain watchlist (POST — this writes and consumes your per-chain quota). The address is stored lowercase so it matches rhc_trades.trader_eoa; a checksummed 0xAbC… would join to nothing and the wallet would look permanently silent. Returns 409 if the wallet is already tracked, and 403 once you are at your tier cap. Tier: PRO+.

label.description: Optional human label (1-64 chars). Omit to leave unlabelled — null is rejected here

wallet_address.description: Wallet EVM address to track (0x, 40 hex). Lowercased on write

name: rhc_wallet_tracker_add
